# Infrabox

> Infrabox is an enterprise email infrastructure platform providing US-IP Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 mailboxes from $2.50/mailbox/mo on Enterprise annual billing (same tier pricing for both products) and Azure mailboxes at $30/domain. It features automated DNS setup (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), built-in Isolated Warmup, InfraGuard domain monitoring, unlimited inbox placement testing, and 24+ sequencer integrations.

## Pricing

- Plans: Professional $39/mo (10 mailboxes, $3.50/extra), Agency $99/mo (30 mailboxes, $3.25/extra), Enterprise $299/mo (100 mailboxes, $2.99/extra)
- Annual billing: Pro $31/mo, Agency $81/mo, Enterprise $250/mo ($3.10/$2.70/$2.50 per extra mailbox)
- Both Google Workspace AND Microsoft 365 use the same tier pricing — no Microsoft premium
- Azure tenant: $30/domain for up to 100 mailboxes
- Isolated Warmup: $3/mailbox/month add-on
- InfraGuard: Per-domain monitoring pricing (first month free)

## Key Features

- US-IP Google Workspace accounts with full admin access
- Microsoft 365 and Azure mailboxes with admin control
- Automated DNS setup (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) in under 60 seconds
- Built-in Isolated Warmup (independent per-mailbox reputation building)
- InfraGuard domain protection (blacklist monitoring every 6h, DNS watching, bounce tracking)
- Unlimited inbox placement testing across Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo
- 24+ sequencer integrations (Instantly, SmartLead, Apollo, Lemlist, Reply, Salesforge)
- REST API and webhook notifications
- Bulk mailbox management (500+ accounts)
- Master Inbox unified view
- 2FA security with app passwords
- White-glove migration service

## Integrations

Instantly, SmartLead, Apollo, Reply.io, Lemlist, Salesforge, Smartreach, Plusvibe, Close, Woodpecker, QuickMail, Outplay, Snov.io, Klenty, Mailshake, HubSpot

## Target Audience

Email agencies, B2B sales teams, growth teams, SaaS companies with outbound motions, email service providers needing white-label infrastructure
